name: Pirate Interdiction Probe
description: Your sub-light engines shudder as an armed Vaelen Syndicate gunship exits stealth mode directly ahead!

options.text: [Piloting 5] Execute high-g maneuver to evade targeting locks.
[Persuasion 6] Transmit forged merchant credentials and bribe codes.
Power up weapon batteries and engage!

name: Cryo-Pod Distress Signal
description: You detect an automated distress signal transmitting from an ancient escape pod adrift near an asteroid belt.

options.text: [Engineering 4] Scan and safely unseal the cryo-containment seals.
Ignore the signal and keep flying.
